tone_notes: Plain, upbeat, practical. Short sentences. No hype.
product_specs: In-ear wireless earbuds with a pocket-sized charging case. USB-C charging.
target_customer: Commuters who want earbuds that last the whole day
approved_facts: The charging case holds three full charges of the earbuds
The earbuds play for up to 6 hours on one charge
The case fits in a jeans pocket
approved_claims: Up to 24 hours of listening with the case
banned_claims: Any medical or health claim, such as protecting or improving hearing or treating tinnitus
Noise cancelling superlatives, such as the best noise cancelling or blocks all noise
audience_notes: Urban commuters aged 20 to 40, mostly on public transport.
